missing_elements: Context & Motivation: Ticket defers to an external Google Doc (Approach B) without summarizing why integration is needed, expected impact, or pain points in the ticket text itself
User Personas / Actors: No roles identified (e.g., cluster admin, support engineer, operator maintainer)
Acceptance Criteria & Edge Cases: Single process criterion ('reviewed and approved') with no technical or functional conditions for the proposal content
Scope Boundaries & Dependencies: No in-scope/out-of-scope items, no dependency on must-gather-clean APIs, operator CRDs, or deployment constraints
Detailed Impacted Repositories / Systems: must-gather-clean and must-gather-operator are named but integration touchpoints (APIs, controllers, job templates) are not specified

quality_issues.quote: Based on the Approach B, create an enhancement proposal
quality_issues.suggestion: Summarize Approach B key decisions in the ticket or jira-spec.md (integration pattern, data flow, ownership boundaries) so downstream artifacts do not depend solely on an external Google Doc.

Add testable acceptance criteria for the proposal artifact itself, e.g., 'Proposal documents integration architecture, API/CR changes, migration path, and verification strategy' with explicit checklist items.
Define concrete integration outcomes: e.g., post-gather cleanup hook, new CR field, sidecar container, or webhook — with Given/When/Then scenarios for expected operator behavior.
